business_problem: Need to fuel innovation and enterprise productivity In its pursuit to transform the business operations of its customers, Genpact was constrained by its dependence on manual tasks.
solution_summary: Genpact used Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Document Intelligence, Azure AI Translator to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Low-code automation and copilot capabilities orchestrate tasks, route work, and surface context to agents or business users without requiring separate point solutions. The company serves and transforms leading enterprises, including the Fortune Global 500, with its deep business and industry knowledge, digital operations services, and expertise in data, technology, and AI. The architecture emphasizes managed services, reusable integrations, and governed data handling so the organization can scale adoption without rebuilding the solution for each new team or use case.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Foundry
solution_components.role: Provides the managed environment for model orchestration, experimentation, and responsible AI operations.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Document Intelligence
solution_components.role: Extracts text, layout, and document fields before downstream AI or analytics processing.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Translator
solution_components.role: Translates multilingual content and inputs inside the workflow.

solution_components.name: Power Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code automation and application platform for workflow modernization.

solution_components.name: Azure Blob Storage
solution_components.role: Stores files, documents, and other unstructured objects used by the solution.
